title: Programming Languages Overview
content: Programming language overview: Python (data/AI, easy), JavaScript/TypeScript (web), Java (enterprise/Android), C++ (systems/games), C# (.NET/Unity), Go (cloud/backend), Rust (systems/safe), Swift (iOS), Kotlin (Android), PHP (web), Ruby (web), SQL (databases).
snippet:
Python    - Data science, AI, scripting
JavaScript - Web, Node.js
TypeScript - Typed JavaScript
Java      - Enterprise, Android
C++       - Games, systems, performance
Go        - Cloud, backend, DevOps
Rust      - Safe systems programming
Swift     - iOS/macOS
Kotlin    - Android modern
C#        - .NET, Unity games

title: C++ Basics
content: C++: compiled, performance-critical. Key concepts: pointers/references, RAII (resource acquisition is initialization), STL containers (vector, map), smart pointers (unique_ptr, shared_ptr), templates, classes, memory management (new/delete).

title: Java Basics
content: Java: JVM-based, compiled to bytecode. Concepts: classes, interfaces, generics, exceptions, streams, collections (List, Map, Set), Maven/Gradle builds, Spring framework for enterprise. Write once, run anywhere.

title: Go (Golang) Basics
content: Go: compiled, simple, concurrent. Goroutines for concurrency, channels for communication, defer for cleanup, interfaces for polymorphism, structs for data. Built-in http server, no framework needed. Great for cloud/backends.

title: Rust Basics
content: Rust: memory-safe systems language. Ownership rules prevent data races. Borrowing (&) and lifetimes. Cargo package manager. Enums with pattern matching, Options and Results for error handling. No garbage collector.

title: Kotlin Basics
content: Kotlin: modern JVM language, official for Android. Null safety with ?, data classes, coroutines for async, extension functions, smart casts. Interoperates with Java.

title: C# Basics
content: C#: .NET language for Windows, web (ASP.NET Core), Unity games. Properties, LINQ queries, async/await, delegates/lambdas, generics, garbage collection. NuGet for packages.

title: PHP Basics
content: PHP: server-side scripting for web. Popular frameworks: Laravel, Symfony. WordPress built on PHP. Variables with $, associative arrays, sessions, PDO for databases. Modern PHP 8+ with typed properties.
snippet:
<?php
$name = 'World';
echo "Hello, $name!";

// Associative array
$user = ['name' => 'Alice', 'age' => 30];
echo $user['name'];

// PDO
$pdo = new PDO('mysql:host=localhost;dbname=test', 'user', 'pass');
$stmt = $pdo->prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?');
$stmt->execute([1]);

title: Swift Basics
content: Swift: Apple's language for iOS/macOS/watchOS. Optionals, structs vs classes, closures, protocol-oriented programming, SwiftUI framework. ARC memory management. Playgrounds for learning.

title: Ruby & Rails Basics
content: Ruby: elegant, developer-friendly language. Ruby on Rails: full-stack framework with conventions. Blocks/procs/lambdas, symbols, metaprogramming, gems for packages. ActiveRecord ORM.
snippet:
class User < ApplicationRecord
  validates :email, presence: true
  has_many :posts
end

# In controller
class UsersController < ApplicationController
  def index
    @users = User.all
  end

  def create
    User.create(user_params)
  end
end

title: HTML & CSS Essentials
content: HTML defines structure: headers, paragraphs, links, forms, semantic elements (header, nav, main, section, article, footer). CSS styles: selectors, box model, flexbox, grid, responsive design, animations.
snippet:
<html>
<head>
  <style>
    .container {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
    }
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .container { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <header><nav>...</nav></header>
  <main class="container">...</main>
  <footer>...</footer>
</body>
</html>

title: Shell Scripting (Bash)
content: Bash scripting: variables, conditionals (if/then), loops (for, while), functions, pipes, redirection, command substitution, exit codes. chmod +x to make executable. Shebang #!/bin/bash.
snippet:
#!/bin/bash

NAME="World"
echo "Hello, $NAME!"

for file in *.txt; do
    echo "Processing $file"
done

if [ -f "important.txt" ]; then
    echo "File exists"
else
    echo "Missing"
fi

# Function
function greet() {
    echo "Hi $1"
}
greet "Alice"

title: AI Development Concepts
content: AI/ML: supervised vs unsupervised learning, neural networks (layers, neurons, activation), LLMs (transformer architecture, attention), embeddings, fine-tuning, RAG (retrieval augmented generation), prompt engineering. Key tools: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Transformers.
snippet:
Machine Learning types:
- Supervised: labeled data
- Unsupervised: patterns
- Reinforcement: rewards

LLM stack:
- Base model (pre-trained)
- Fine-tuning (domain)
- RAG (knowledge)
- Prompt engineering

Embeddings: text → vectors

title: Database Concepts
content: Databases: SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) relational with ACID transactions. NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis) for flexibility/scale. Indexes speed lookups. Normalization reduces redundancy. Transactions ensure consistency.
